Ok, here is a bug:

----
➜  orbit git:(main) ✗ orbit app:new

 ┌ Select target node: ─────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │ NMBP, app-dev, 10.6.0.3, active                              │
 └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

 ┌ App name (slug): ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │ test                                                         │
 └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


  ┌  Creating App
  │
  ●  Record operation state  Operation dac1a7e6-f094-4a9b-8061-4a100eb435df running
  │
  ●  Create app source       Source creation for app 'test' failed on node 'NMBP'.
  │
  ○  Write app registry
  │
  ○  Apply app runtime
  │
  └  Source creation for app 'test' failed on node 'NMBP'.

➜  orbit git:(main) ✗
----

I got prompted properly to choose a node first, then asked for a name and then it try to create it. That is not what the contract says:

when no params are passed ask:
1. which node
2. The name (slug)
3. new or clone
4. If new ask for template repo, if clone as for repo
5. ask for new repo name when new from template
6. install on node

The contract may be more precise and im leaving out some steps

expectation: Resolve a complete source plan before starting app creation

protection.rejected_example: After node and slug, app:new starts source creation without asking new or clone
protection.accepted_example: After node and slug, app:new asks new or clone and resolves the selected repository details before gateway I/O
